# GasFree attribution

GasFree creation bytecode and test vectors originate from gasfreeio/gasfree-sdk-js 1.1.4, licensed under Apache-2.0 (see LICENSE).

https://github.com/gasfreeio/gasfree-sdk-js

Relevant files: src/constant/common.ts and src/tests/constant.ts. Coffer implements the documented fixed mainnet address derivation and TIP-712 PermitTransfer encoding using its existing cryptographic libraries; it does not embed the JavaScript or iOS runtime.
